LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kaftan.label: silk kaftan
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kaftan.description: A long open coat of red silk lined with cotton, embroidered at the hems and closed with a gold sash. Warm on the plateau at night and splendid at court.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_ScaleCoat.label: immortal's scale coat
LanguageData.HE_Pars_ScaleCoat.description: A knee-length coat of small iron scales sewn on leather, worn under the robe so that an enemy never knows who is armoured.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_WingedHelm.label: winged helmet
LanguageData.HE_Pars_WingedHelm.description: A tall pointed helmet with a mail curtain over the neck and two gilded wings on the brow, the sign of a guard captain.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kidaris.label: kidaris
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kidaris.description: The tall fluted tiara of the King of Kings, banded with gold and turquoise. To wear it upright is the king's right alone.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Candys.label: candys
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Candys.description: A long crimson robe with hanging sleeves worn over the shoulders, given by the king to those he wishes to honour.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Chokha.label: chokha
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Chokha.description: A long fitted coat with rows of silver cartridge loops across the chest and a narrow dark belt.
